selection_rationale: autocand-2026-01 directly addresses an operationally meaningful, falsifiable gap (compare tool-augmentation vs constrained decoding under adversarial intents) with a paired design aligned to the evidence-synthesis gaps (Q3). It balances novelty, venue relevance, and feasible model-call budget while presenting a clear, testable primary outcome; outstanding reviewer repairs are addressable before preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: Validator coverage and accuracy (how well deterministic validators reflect true semantic correctness in diverse vendor configs).
Adversarial-intent generation specification and safe-release policy (risk of enabling misuse if attack generators are published).
Dataset provenance, licensing, and selection for the 600 intent corpus (public redistributability and archival).
Statistical power justification for the proposed N=600 paired tasks (sensitivity for primary McNemar test and minimum detectable effect).
Exact frozen experimental controls: model identifier(s), prompt templates, decoding parameters, random seeds, and retry policy must be specified and fixed prior to execution.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Provide explicit validator specifications, coverage matrix, and an evaluation of validator correctness (e.g., validator vs expert spot checks).
Define and document the adversarial-intent generation algorithm, plus a responsible-disclosure and redaction/safety policy for any adversarial artifacts to prevent misuse.
Publish dataset provenance and licensing for all vendor-derived configs; replace or redact any non-redistributable items and include hashing/archival plan for reproducibility.
Perform and record a pre-experiment power analysis to justify the 600 paired-task sample (or adjust sample size accordingly) with assumed baseline failure rates and minimum detectable difference.

Freeze and record exact experimental controls in a preregistration JSON: chosen hosted-model identifier(s), full prompt templates, decoding/temperature/top-k parameters, max per-task call budget, random seeds, and the retry/error-recovery policy.
